Agoura Hills City Council
AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE
AGOURA HILLS CITY COUNCIL
Civic Center – Council Chambers
30001 Ladyface Court, Agoura Hills, California 91301
Friday, May 22, 2020
1:00 P.M.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, individuals with a disability who plan to attend or otherwise participate in this meeting and who may require any accommodation should contact the City Clerk's Office at least 48 hours before the meeting either in person at City Hall or by telephone at (818) 597-7303.
Assisted Listening is available in the Council Chambers. Prior to the meeting, please contact the City Clerk to arrange for use of a personal listening device.
Any person who wishes to speak regarding an item on the regular agenda, or on a subject within the City's jurisdiction during "Public Comments", is requested to submit a "Speaker's Card" with the City Clerk before that portion of the Agenda is called.
Please turn off all cell phones and other electronic devices during the meeting.
Agenda CS 05-22-20
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL:
Mayor Illece Buckley Weber
Mayor Pro Tem Denis Weber
Councilmember Chris Anstead
Councilmember Deborah Klein Lopez
Councilmember Linda L. Northrup
PUBLIC COMMENTS
(This section is reserved for persons wishing to speak on items not listed on the Agenda that are under the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council. Please submit a "Speaker's Card" to the City Clerk and limit testimony to three (3) minutes .)
CLOSED SESSION
1.
Public Employee Performance Evaluation – Government Code Section 54957(b) Title: City Manager
